Lena Ortiz: Heads-up: product asked why the rollout cost card shows a 12% savings but the per-tenant billing forecast shows ~0%. They compared same time window. Anyone seen this before?
Rajiv Menon: Two likely culprits: 1) our preview uses a 7-day amortization horizon by default for model warmup; billing forecast uses 90d smoothed baseline. 2) cache decay assumptions differwe assume exponential decay with half-life=6h in preview, billing sim used linear decay.
Evan Park: Oof. We exposed cache_decay in the preview API (decay: exponential|linear, half_life_hours:int). Example payload we support: POST /api/cost_preview {route: "webhook", mode: "amortized", decay: "exponential", half_life_hours: 6} but Console hides it.
Lena Ortiz: Product wants Console defaults to reflect billing to avoid surprises. Can we change UI default to decay: linear and horizon: 90d? That seems heavy-handed.
Rajiv Menon: Don't change defaults without flag; many teams rely on fast previews. Suggestion: keep fast defaults in "what-if" but add a selector: "Estimation horizon" with options Quick(7d)-Analyst(30d)-Billing(90d). Also surface which decay model is used and a link "See billing assumptions".
Evan Park: Also add a tiny inline comparator line: "Preview vs Billing baseline: +12% vs +0% (horizon=7d vs 90d, decay=exp vs linear)" so users immediately see drivers.
qa-bot: Reminder: add unit-tests covering decay variants and horizon mapping to billing sim. See ticket INF-712.
deploy-bot: Created PR https://redwood.internal/pulls/4922 "console: preview horizon selector + decay exposer" by Evan Park.
Lena Ortiz: Great. One more: product asked for a per-route "lift confidence" score based on variance from sampled token traces. Can we compute a simple z-score comparing sampled vs modelled token mix?
Rajiv Menon: We can, but beware of teams misinterpreting z-scores. Suggest percent-band and color coding: Low (<10%), Medium (10-25%), High (>25%). That maps well to UI.
Evan Park: I'll add the banding and a tooltip: "Confidence uses sampled token mix variance; high means numbers may diverge from billing."
Lena Ortiz: Perfect. Please ensure the preview API returns metadata keys: estimation_horizon, cache_decay, confidence_band. We'll also add a tiny footer note in Console.
Rajiv Menon: Filing follow-ups and will sync with billing team to ensure horizon mappings match their 90d baseline.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks all.
